sentences.l2: 世界有些公司做机器人和电脑。
sentences.l1: Some companies in the world make robots and computers.

sentences.l2: 这些机器可以学习人的工作。
sentences.l1: These machines can learn people's work.

sentences.l2: 一些公司让机器工作，所以人不能工作了。
sentences.l1: Some companies let machines work, so people cannot work any more.

sentences.l2: 很多人担心自己会没有工作。
sentences.l1: Many people worry that they will have no work.
The government should help these people.

sentences.l2: 政府可以让这些人学习新技能。
sentences.l1: The government can let these people learn new skills.

sentences.l2: 学习后，他们可以做别的工作。
sentences.l1: After learning, they can do other work.
Money must also be distributed fairly.

sentences.l2: 有些人有很多钱，有些人没有钱。
sentences.l1: Some people have a lot of money, and some people have no money.

sentences.l2: 未来，机器会帮我们做事。
sentences.l1: In the future, machines will help us do things.

sentences.l2: 人可以休息多一点，或做喜欢的事。
sentences.l1: People can rest a little more, or do things they like.

sentences.l2: 大家要一起想办法，让生活变得更好。
sentences.l1: Everyone should think of ways together to make life better.
